source: DCA Airtable Implementation Standard, attached document, sections 3–5 and 8A

fields.name: project
fields.description: Formula display of the separate generated ID and readable name, following DCA Airtable Implementation Standard section 4. Used for recognition; edit the name field, not this derived display.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: Generated Airtable identifier: PRJ- plus RECORD_ID(). Prefix is explicit table configuration. Kept separate from the primary display. Preserve external references and old-to-new ID mappings when migrating; do not regenerate IDs without reconciliation.

fields.name: lifecycle_status
fields.description:
Current project lifecycle; independent of validation, procurement outcomes and technical build readiness. Blank means not recorded, not confirmation or a negative result.
Options:
preparation — Scope and support are being prepared; does not imply launched outreach or procurement.
active — Project work is actually underway under established ownership; not proof of fulfillment.
paused — Work is intentionally on hold; preserve reason and next decision.
completed — Project work is explicitly concluded at its stated scope; not automatic proof that every Need was met.
cancelled — Project has been stopped without completion; preserve the decision and sources.

fields.name: validation_status
fields.description:
Evidence validation at the scope stated in validation_scope; independent of lifecycle and processing. Blank means not recorded, not confirmation or a negative result.
Options:
confirmed_at_stated_scope — Evidence supports exactly validation_scope; not blanket approval, procurement authority or fulfillment.
pending_validation — A source claim exists but the relevant current facts still need confirmation; do not treat as confirmed.
disputed — Relevant sources or validators conflict; preserve the conflict and do not silently choose one.
unknown — Validation position has not been established; not a negative finding.

fields.name: processing_status
fields.description:
State of preparing and reconciling this record; this is not an outreach, goods or delivery state. Blank means not recorded, not confirmation or a negative result.
Options:
prepared — Record and sources are prepared for the next review/action; not evidence that operations have started.
awaiting_input — Progress depends on identified missing information or a decision; keep that dependency in open_questions/next_action.
maintained — Record is being kept current through an established maintenance process; does not confirm every claim.
needs_reconciliation — Sources, mappings or records require reconciliation before reliable further use; not the same as a disputed underlying claim.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Native record creation timestamp. Technical metadata, not project start, source date or goods receipt. ISO date, 24-hour time, Europe/Amsterdam display.

fields.name: last_modified
fields.description: Native timestamp of the latest edit to editable fields. Technical metadata, not evidence of outreach or goods movement. Tracks all editable fields; ISO date, 24-hour time, Europe/Amsterdam display.

fields.name: need
fields.description: Formula display of the separate generated ID and readable name, following DCA Airtable Implementation Standard section 4. Used for recognition; edit the name field, not this derived display.

fields.name: need_id
fields.description: Generated Airtable identifier: NED- plus RECORD_ID(). Prefix is explicit table configuration. Kept separate from the primary display. Preserve external references and old-to-new ID mappings when migrating; do not regenerate IDs without reconciliation.

fields.name: need_type
fields.description:
Whose requirement this represents; civilian demand and DCA operational capacity must remain separate. Blank means not recorded, not confirmation or a negative result.
Options:
civilian_assistance — Requirement for civilian assistance; retain recipient/context and validation scope. Do not use for DCA's own packing supplies.
dca_operational_capacity — Requirement supporting DCA's own operation, such as packing supplies; receipt is not civilian delivery.
unknown — Beneficiary/use is unresolved; do not infer either civilian demand or DCA operational need.

fields.name: quantity_precision
fields.description:
Certainty of the required quantity; unknown quantities remain blank and cannot yield a fulfillment percentage. Blank means not recorded, not confirmation or a negative result.
Options:
unknown — Required amount is not sufficiently established; leave quantity blank. Blank does not mean zero.
exact — Source supports the stated single numeric amount and unit at the stated scope; not an arbitrary target.
approximate — Source explicitly qualifies an amount as approximate; preserve the original wording in requirement/specification/source evidence. Do not force a range into one exact quantity.

fields.name: lifecycle_status
fields.description:
State of the requirement itself; candidate is unresolved demand and open does not imply procurement has started. Blank means not recorded, not confirmation or a negative result.
Options:
candidate — Sourced requirement under consideration; current demand is not yet confirmed.
open — Requirement remains unmet at its stated scope; no procurement or quantity implied.
partially_met — Evidence establishes some of the requirement met and some remaining; not inferred from an offer alone.
met — Evidence establishes fulfillment of the defined requirement; distinguish DCA receipt from civilian delivery.
withdrawn — Requirement has been explicitly withdrawn or superseded; preserve source/reason, not mark as fulfilled.
